P.name: Clean Cuts
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} shot by '''Xayah''' will linger and be planted in the ground at maximum range for 6 seconds.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Xayah's''' {{tip|ability}} casts generate 3 {{tip|stacks}} of ''Clean Cuts'', lasting for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts, and stacking up to 5 times. '''Xayah's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to each consume a stack {{tip|on-attack}} to instead shoot a {{as|Feather|buzzword}} that deals the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} to the primary target and {{as|{{pp|key=%|35 to 55 for 3|1 to 13}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to other enemies hit. The secondary target damage can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Xayah|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage if the triggering attack does.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Xayah''' or {{ci|Rakan}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.

Q.name: Double Daggers
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' barrages two {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} in the target direction that each deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Hit|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*2 to 105*2}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: Targets hit after the first take 50% reduced damage.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Reduced Damage per Hit|{{ap|45/2 to 105/2}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Reduced Damage|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.cast time: {{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|round=3|0.25;0.033*7;0.033*6;0.033*5;0.033*4;0.1|key1=%|0;27.15;74.29;121.43;168.58;214.3|formula=0.25-(0.07 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed). ''This is capped at 60% reduction at 214.3% '''bonus''' attack speed.''|color=attack speed}}

W.name: Deadly Plumage
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' enters a frenzy for 4 seconds, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and causing her {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} to be empowered to fire an additional smaller feather at the target {{tip|on-hit}} that deals 25% damage of the triggering {{as|attack's damage}}.
W.description2: Whenever '''Xayah''' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with the strike, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description3: ''If {{ci|Rakan}} is nearby upon cast, he also becomes empowered, and gains the {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} at the same time as '''Xayah'''.''

E.name: Bladecaller
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' recalls all planted {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} to shoot back to her, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 50|critScaling=true}}. ''Bladecaller'' deals 50% damage to {{tip|minions}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Feather|{{ap|50 to 110}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion Damage Per Feather|{{ap|50/2 to 110/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40/2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
E.description2: An enemy takes {{pp|type=previous feathers hit|key=%|100 to 10 by 5|x-1|formula=100%-(5% per previous feather hit). ''This is capped at 10% damage.''}} damage from a {{as|Feather|buzzword}}.
E.description3: A target hit by at least three {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} is {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
E.description4: ''A planted {{as|Feather|buzzword}} is required to cast this ability. Enemies can be hit by an individual {{as|Feather|buzzword}} only once per pass.''

R.name: Featherstorm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' leaps into the air, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. After 1 second, she shoots 5 {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} in a cone in the target direction that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
R.description2: '''''Xayah''' is unable to basic attack or cast abilities during Featherstorm, but can still move.''
